page: Microsoft Azure EC4eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEDV6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and features 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

For local storage needs, the EC4eds_v6 includes a bundled 236 GB NVMe SSD. Additionally, the instance is premium storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes. No dedicated GPU hardware is included in this configuration.

From a resource density perspective, this instance offers a cost-effective profile for workloads requiring a larger memory footprint relative to compute capacity without the overhead of a higher vCPU tier. The combination of dedicated Intel vCPUs, 32.0 GB of RAM, and fast local NVMe storage makes this server suitable for memory-intensive workloads, relational databases, caching layers, and data buffering applications.

This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-bound tasks that do not require massive parallel compute. It is well-suited for database hosting, in-memory caching, and medium-scale enterprise applications requiring reliable memory density and fast local temporary storage.
